ablations.name: lexical context only
ablations.what_breaks: The handoff can retrieve RetryPolicy evidence but cannot show which exact test symbol constructs it.

ablations.name: bounded typed graph expansion
ablations.what_breaks_without_it: An agent must reopen and reinterpret the test file to discover the test-to-production relationship.

retention_decision: Retain the bounded graph for relationship questions; keep lexical retrieval as the default handoff baseline.
limits: One synthetic Python relationship; this is not a general accuracy benchmark.
JavaScript and TypeScript extraction are covered by deterministic tests, not this case.
No embedding or external model was used, so cost is zero but semantic recall is unmeasured.
Latency is a local point-in-time measurement and not a production service-level claim.
